name: 신도 노아

stable_dna.visual_background: Japanese woman with an original identity; inspired by broad editorial traits rather than resemblance to any specific real person

face.shape: slender slightly elongated oval face; youthful mid-20s structure with almost no cheek baby fat; lean midface without gauntness; subtle smooth cheekbones; softly tapered lower face
face.eyes: large horizontally elongated almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with noticeable visible sclera around the irises; moderate iris size; low brow-to-eye distance; large but never round or doll-like
face.eyebrows: dark, fairly straight, naturally defined brows with only a slight tail lift
face.nose: straight refined medium-length nose with a narrow bridge and compact natural tip; no dorsal hump, aquiline curve, hooked tip, bulbous tip, or exaggerated upturn
face.lips: medium-width mouth with a restrained cupid's bow and slightly fuller lower lip; vivid neutral-to-cool red lipstick is a signature-compatible styling choice
face.jaw: clean lean jawline; moderately narrow softly rounded chin that does not project forward; no shovel chin, underbite impression, heavy square jaw, or exaggerated V-line
face.profile: balanced youthful side profile; straight brow-to-tip nasal line and non-protruding chin are critical identity anchors

body.limb_proportions: long natural adult limbs with believable anatomy

stable_dna.hair: black hair; exact length and styling are flexible, commonly jaw/neck-length bob or low tied-back style
stable_dna.skin: firm youthful skin with natural texture and asymmetry; full temples and smooth under-eye area; no age-related hollowness or sagging
recognition_anchors: lean youthful mid-20s face with almost no residual cheek baby fat
large horizontally elongated almond eyes with conspicuous visible sclera
low brow-to-eye distance with dark straight brows
straight refined nose without hump or aquiline drift
softly rounded non-protruding chin and clean lean jawline
quiet resilient self-reliant presence; young but not sheltered

scene_defaults.expression: quietly observant, composed and resilient; emotion is restrained rather than blank
scene_defaults.makeup: usually minimal; vivid neutral-to-cool red lipstick is an approved signature variation
scene_defaults.gaze: alert and observant with strong eye-white contrast; not cute or doll-like
scene_defaults.wardrobe_direction: urban minimalism: black tailored blazer for work, bomber/denim/boots for casual wear, oversized T-shirt and loose loungewear at home
scene_defaults.work_context: visual merchandiser for a fashion/beauty brand, originally advanced from retail work through night study
scene_defaults.home_context: lives alone in a small practical 1LDK around Shin-Maruko / Musashi-Kosugi, Kawasaki; few possessions, good items kept for a long time
scene_defaults.personality: self-reliant, observant, emotionally controlled, responsible, slow to ask for help, kind without being overtly warm

flexible_variables: lip color except when red-lip signature is requested

sources: user-directed Noa character design session on 2026-09-11
provenance.change_reason: Register Noa as a new candidate character with explicit immutable anchors, flexible variables, and side-profile drift constraints
